CustomField.description: Whether this source can hold a start date. When false, Apex refuses a start date on the source's items and the board offers no start date editor - hiding the editor is presentation, the refusal is the rule. Which vendor field holds the date is a separate fact and lives with the adapter, in a Field_Mapping__mdt row of type Field. False by default, so a new source never inherits a capability by accident.
CustomField.label: Supports Start Date
